Watch 'That Thrifting Show with Lara Spencer: Holiday Edition – Sleigh the Family Room!' Thursday, Dec. 3

By Jim Donnelly
Nov 23rd, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:54
Instaread

Television host and vintage design expert Lara Spencer brings secondhand style home for the holidays in "That Thrifting Show with Lara Spencer: Holiday Edition – Sleigh the Family Room!" Executive produced and hosted by Spencer, the thrifting and design competition series returns with a special edition premiering Thursday, Dec. 3 (10:00-11:00 p.m. EST/PST), on Freeform and streaming next day on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ for bundle subscribers in the U.S.

"That Thrifting Show with Lara Spencer: Holiday Edition" | Official Trailer | Freeform

With just two days and a limited budget, Team "English Christmas" and Team "Retro Holiday" race to find, repurpose and style their thrifted finds, transforming empty spaces into festive family rooms. The winning team must stay true to its design theme, putting together a polished room ready for holiday gatherings all while racing against the clock.

Fan-favorite contestants from the first season of "That Thrifting Show" were invited back to deck the halls and hunt for treasures, including Christine Escribano, Katie Malatesta, Zac Mathias and Emma Rojas.

Beginning with this special holiday edition and continuing through next year's upcoming second season, designer, DIY expert, content creator and author Clare Sullivan joins returning design experts Robert Hartwell and Preston Konrad on the judging panel. Together, they will decide which team makes the most of its secondhand finds and delivers the winning holiday transformation. It's a merry thrift-off viewers won't want to miss.

The series is produced for ABC News Studios by Butternut, a division of Wheelhouse, and Envisionary Productions. Lara Spencer serves as executive producer, alongside Courtney White and Cheryl Wayne. Aurora Ferrara is co-executive producer for Butternut, and Jon Rosen is co-executive producer for Envisionary Productions. David Sloan is senior executive producer and Melia Patria is executive producer for ABC News Studios.
